text:
Mira T (Partnerships): Quick heads-up AtlasFlow (orchestrator) wants a bundled Marketplace tile showing LangChain + our gateway + orchestration hooks. They asked for a private-onprem checklist, perf numbers on their cluster, and an embargoed joint announcement in mid-July. Thoughts? :mag:

Ethan V (Eng): From eng: do they need full LlamaIndex examples or is LangChain + simple vector-store enough? Also need service-account scope details for Orch auth.

Mira T (Partnerships): AtlasFlow prefers a minimal LlamaIndex retrieval example so customers can see retrieval + job orchestration. They also want clear notes on onboarding when Private -> hosted fallbacks happen.

Yuki H (Product): Marketplace deliverables: SKU tiers (starter / business / enterprise), support matrix, network/KMS notes for Private, and a short resilience spec for fallbacks. I can draft SKU text if we have perf baseline.

Sam P (DevEx): I'll assemble a demo repo with two workflows: 1) LangChain agent hitting the gateway; 2) OrchX job that scales workers and triggers fallback to quantized model. Repo will include terraform snippet and a small GH Actions sample. ETA PR in 48h.

Rae K (Marketing): Timeline: AtlasFlow wants assets for PR review by July 10 and embargoed publish July 17. We need a 1-pager, co-demo script (90s), and partner portal copy. Legal ok with embargo? @Jorge L

Jorge L (Legal): Embargo fine but need dataflow + coop language. If we call any badge "Validated on AtlasFlow" we should avoid "Certified" until a full ops checklist is done. Also confirm no customer keys leave customer's KMS.

Ethan V (Eng): Technical caveat: AtlasFlow's control plane sets a custom KMS policy that requires our sidecar to accept external wrap keys. That's an ops ask; if we can't support external wrap, fallback is documented. I'll paste minimal repro and a workaround.

Sam P (DevEx): Repro snippet:
```
# repro: AtlasFlow KMS handshake failure
1) start gateway with EXTERNAL_WRAP=true
2) Orch job requests wrapped-key
# observed: handshake timeout
# temporary workaround: use REDWOOD_KMS_EMULATOR=1 locally or instruct customer to allow our wrap service
```

SchedulerBot: perf-job scheduled. Tag: atlasflow-orch-2678. Provide GCS path with prompts and model list CSV.

Sam P (DevEx): I'll upload prompts and Orch workflow to gs://redwood-partners/atlasflow-orch-2678 by EOD tomorrow and open PR: https://github.com/redwood-repo/atlasflow-orch-demo/pull/15

Yuki H (Product): Perf matrix: run redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q4, and redwood-13b-int8; seq 512 & 2048; batching 1,4. Also test cold-start under orchestration scale-up. Include 95th latency and cost per 1k tokens.

Ethan V (Eng): Note on orchestration: AtlasFlow uses ephemeral service accounts. We need a short doc showing required IAM scopes: compute.instances.run, storage.objects.get, kms.cryptoUnwrap. I'll draft.

Jorge L (Legal): Also include a short clause in coop wording: partner owns hardware/fleet maintenance and is responsible for kernel/driver updates required for zero-copy paths. We'll flag that in marketplace support matrix.

Rae K (Marketing): I'll draft the one-pager and the co-demo script but will wait for perf numbers. Using "Validated on AtlasFlow" language for now. Once legal clears, we'll include the embargo copy.

Mira T (Partnerships): Action recap:
- Ethan: IAM scopes + compat caveats + upload compat matrix (due TOM)
- Sam: demo repo + prompts to GCS (due EOD tomorrow)
- Yuki: SKU/support copy + fallback wording (due in 4 days)
- Jorge: legal coop draft once dataflow posted (due in 3 business days)
- Rae: marketing assets after perf (draft due July 5)

Ethan V (Eng): Kicking off perf runs after Sam uploads prompts. Leaving note: also capture memory footprint when Orch scales to 4 workers.

Sam P (DevEx): PR opened and bucket ready: https://github.com/redwood-repo/atlasflow-orch-demo/pull/15 and gs://redwood-partners/atlasflow-orch-2678

Mira T (Partnerships): Solid. Let's reconvene next Tue 9am PT to review perf and legal wording. Thanks team :tada:
